column1: # telemetry-off targets. Verified against webOS TV 4.10.0 / 05.40.45.
#   binary       path to stub with a bind mount ("-" = stop only, no stub).
#                Running copies inside an app jail are killed, not stubbed.
#   upstart-job  job to `initctl stop` ("-" = none). A job is always stopped
#                before its binary's running processes are killed, so a
#                respawn job never loops on the stub.
# Groups are enabled by TARGET_GROUPS in telemetry-off.conf.
# Launch mode and evidence for every line: docs/telemetry.md.
